title: C++ Low-Level Systems & GPU Kernel Mastery
subtitle: From Zero-Cost Abstractions to Saturating GPU Memory Bandwidth & Tensor Cores

volumes.title: Volume 1: C++ Low-Level Systems Foundations
volumes.tagline: Pointer arithmetic, strides, memory alignment, cache lines, custom arenas, zero-copy buffers
volumes.description: Master stack/heap dynamics, raw byte arithmetic, memory alignment, SIMD vectorization, cache associativity, and atomic acquire-release semantics.

modules.title: Module 5: Concurrency, Atomics, NUMA & High-Throughput I/O
modules.tagline: Acquire-release memory orders, lock-free ring buffers, NUMA topology & io_uring streaming
